Returns all custom referral statuses for your account, ordered by the `order` field ascending. **HTTP Request**
`GET https://api.firstpromoter.com/api/admin/v1/custom_referral_statuses`

info.name: Create, update, or delete custom referral statuses

items.docs:
Batch operation to create, update, and/or delete custom referral statuses in a single request. Pass an array of status objects under the `custom_referral_statuses` key. - **Create**: omit `id` - **Update**: include the existing `id` - **Delete**: include `id` and set `_destroy` to `true` Both `name` and `order` must be unique within your account.
